policy.directory_date: Evidence under docs/rollout-evidence/<YYYY-MM-DD>/ uses the directory name as the authoritative event date (UTC calendar day).
policy.generation_time: Machine JSON evidence should include generated_at or generated_at_utc when emitted by CI scripts; human markdown receipts may use the directory date alone.
policy.commit: Machine receipts should record commit_sha or reproducibility_lock.commit_sha when the emitting tool supports it.
policy.artifact_hash: Paired fingerprint receipts record sha256 of the governing contract/inventory file; drift without an intentional exception fails closed.

intentional_exceptions.reason: Historical observe-mode receipt predates the directory-date + commit hash machine schema; retained as archival evidence.
WS20/WS21 stage receipts are archival; generation timestamps may be embedded in filenames or body text rather than JSON fields.
